map.出汗率估算是做什么的？: What does Sweat Rate Estimator do?
map.如何使用出汗率估算？: How do I use Sweat Rate Estimator?
map.出汗率估算适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Sweat Rate Estimator best for?
map.通过运动前后称重法估算出汗速率、脱水程度与建议补液量: Enter pre- and post-exercise body weight and duration to estimate sweat rate and dehydration percentage by the weighing method, with recommended fluid replacement for endurance training and racing.
map.出汗率 = (运动前−后体重)/时间: Sweat rate = (pre-exercise − post-exercise body weight) / time
map.💡 出汗量 = 运动前体重 − 运动后体重 + 补液量 − 排尿量（1ml 水: 💡 Sweat loss = pre-exercise weight − post-exercise weight + fluid intake − urine output (1 ml of water ≈ 1 g, 1 L ≈ 1 kg). Sweat rate = sweat loss ÷ duration (h).
map.⚠️ 脱水达 2% 即影响运动表现，超过 5% 有热射病风险。称重请着相同衣物，: ⚠️ Dehydration of 2% already impairs performance and over 5% carries heat-stroke risk. Weigh yourself in the same clothing; measuring after emptying the bladder is more accurate.
map.建议在相同条件下重复 2–3 次取平均，提高准确性: Repeat 2-3 times under identical conditions and average the results to improve accuracy
map.补液建议：每 15–20 分钟补充出汗量的 1/4，少量多次: Fluid advice: replace one quarter of the sweat loss every 15-20 minutes, in small frequent amounts
map.长时间运动 (>1h) 建议补充含电解质的运动饮料: For long sessions (>1 h) electrolyte-containing sports drinks are recommended
map.称重法算出汗量指导补液。: Use the weighing method to find sweat loss and guide fluid replacement.
map.高温赛事前称量训练前后体重算出汗率，定制个人补给而非照搬通用建议。: Before a hot-weather event, weigh yourself before and after training to compute your sweat rate and tailor your own fluid plan instead of copying generic advice.
map.运动前 70.0 kg、后 68.8 kg、饮 0.5 L → 出汗≈1.7 L: Pre 70.0 kg, post 68.8 kg, drank 0.5 L → sweat ≈ 1.7 L/h.
map.是，固定条件下排空后称重误差小。: Yes; weighing under fixed conditions after emptying the bladder gives less error.
map.主要是汗液流失，也含呼吸与代谢失水；需扣减训练中饮入量才得净出汗率。: It is mainly sweat loss but also includes respiratory and metabolic water loss; subtract the fluid drunk during training to obtain the net sweat rate.
